properties.name: Intent that must hold no matter what is recorded as inviolable, and a violation is computed, not remembered
properties.statement: A design must be able to record intent that no downstream decision may trade away — a key performance parameter, in the acquisition sense: a threshold that, if missed, fails the effort regardless of how well everything else went. Inviolable intent is distinct from a Requirement (a goal to achieve, tradeable against other goals) and from a Constraint (a limit imposed on the design). reflow2 must (a) let that intent be stated with its threshold and, where it applies, its objective value; (b) COMPUTE a violation rather than rely on anyone remembering — an accepted Decision, an allocation, or a change whose blast radius contradicts a KPP must be surfaced loudly and above ordinary gaps; and (c) show a KPP crossing in impact analysis BEFORE the edit is made, not after it has been committed. A KPP that nothing checks is a comment.
